effects.effect: Your pointy tail allows you to punctuate all your actions. Once per round when you make a [melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), you can deal extra damage with the [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) equal to your highest [characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic) score.
